deep.reconstruction:
The page works with a 2-truncated symmetric simplicial-type structure. There are sets E_0, E_1, E_2 with the following maps:
- face maps p_ij from E_2 to E_1 (p_12, p_23, p_31, also p_13), and p_0 from E_1 to E_0;
- degeneracies δ_0 from E_0 to E_1 and δ_1 from E_1 to E_2;
- an involution σ on E_1 (inverse arrow);
- an action of S_3 on E_2, generated by the cyclic rotation ρ and the transposition σ_1.

The guiding model is coskeletal: E_n = π_0(F^{n+1}) for an object F of a Galois-type (or stratified) category. E_1 is the set of components of F×F and E_2 the set of components of F×F×F, with p_ij induced by the coordinate projections and S_3 permuting the factors. The notation fits this model. For x = (a,b), δ_1(x) = (b,a,a).

Top formulas.
- p_12 δ_1(x) = σ(x).
- p_12 ρ δ_1(x) = p_23 δ_1(x) = δ_0 p_0(x), a degenerate edge.
- p_12 ρ² δ_1(x) = p_31 δ_1(x) = x.

NB. δ_1(x) can be fixed by ρ (hence by S_3) iff x = δ_0 p_0(x), i.e. x is degenerate. This holds because the three edges σx, 1 and x would have to coincide.

Boxed relations. These are the relations defining a groupoid from this data, i.e. the fundamental groupoid of the 2-complex:
- δ_0 p_0(x) = 1 (units);
- σ(x)·x = 1 (inverses);
- p_12(z) p_23(z) p_31(z) = 1 for z in E_2 (triangles give relations).

For a degenerate triangle δ_1(x), the triangle relation reads σ(x)·1·x = 1, which is already implied. Since S_3 permutes a triangle's relations among cyclic rotations and inverses, one needs only one supplementary relation per S_3-orbit in E_2 not meeting δ_1(E_1). This is a minimal presentation of the fundamental groupoid by generators (edge orbits) and relations (non-degenerate triangle orbits).

Lower half.
- Take α in E_1, viewed as a component F_α of F×F, with pr_0 : F_α → F.
- The fibre product F_α ×_F F_α over the first coordinate sits in F×F×F, via ((x,y),(x,y')) ~ (x,y,y').
- Hence π_0(F_α ×_F F_α) = p_12^{-1}(α) ∩ p_13^{-1}(α) =: E_2(α). This set is stable under σ_1, which swaps the last two coordinates.

The argument then runs as follows.
1. Fixed points of σ_1 on E_2 lie in δ_1(E_1).
2. p_12 δ_1(x) = p_13 δ_1(x) = σx, so δ_1(x) ∈ E_2(α) iff x = σα.
3. Hence δ_1σ(α) is the unique σ_1-fixed ("diagonal") component of F_α ×_F F_α. It plays the role of the diagonal F_α → F_α ×_F F_α.

Purpose. This is presumably a step towards computing π_0 of fibre products, and towards deciding when F_α → F is a monomorphism or covering. That would amount to describing fundamental groupoids or Galois data combinatorially from the π_0's of powers of a 'fibre' object, in the context of stratified topoi.
errors: No substantive mathematical errors are visible.
The NB's sufficiency direction tacitly uses that a fully degenerate triangle is S_3-fixed. This is automatic in the coskeletal model π_0(F^3) but not for an arbitrary symmetric 2-truncated structure.
'Prenons α ≠ δ_1' is presumably shorthand for 'α non-degenerate' (α not in δ_0(E_0)); the written δ_2 likely denotes a fully degenerate triangle. The notation is loose.

ideas.what: Presentation of a groupoid from a symmetric 2-truncated simplicial set: units, inverses, one triangle relation per S_3-orbit of non-degenerate 2-simplices
ideas.modern_name: fundamental groupoid of a (symmetric) 2-truncated simplicial set / combinatorial presentation by generators and relations
ideas.where_published: Related material on π_1 of simplicial objects appears in SGA1 and in descent theory; not this exact formulation

ideas.what: E_n = π_0(F^{n+1}) as a coskeletal Čech-type nerve of an object F; computing π_0(F_α ×_F F_α) as p_12^{-1}(α) ∩ p_13^{-1}(α); identifying the diagonal component via σ_1-fixed points
ideas.modern_name: Galois category / Čech nerve of a cover, π_0 of fibre products; diagonal component
ideas.where_published: SGA1 Exp. V (Galois categories, connected components of fibre products)

deep.surprise_reason: These are routine combinatorial verifications about degenerate simplices and the minimal relations of a symmetric 2-truncated nerve. They are a working step in the 'topos stratifié' notes, with no new result or unexplored connection visible on this page.
transcription_corrections: '(x,y)(x',y') ~ (x,[-y-],y')' should read approximately '(x,y),(x,y') ~ (x,y,y')': the fibre product over pr_0, identifying a pair sharing the first coordinate with a triple.
The last line is probably 'et δ_1σ(α) joue le rôle des δ_1 = δ_1(α)' (or similar). The 'répond la vil[?]' reading is doubtful.
In the NB, 'ne peut être fixé par ρ (donc par 𝔖_3) que si x = δ_0p_0(x) (condition néc. et suff.)' is correct.
'(une relation supplémentaire par orbite de 𝔖_3 qui ne rencontre pas δ_1(E_1))': 'de 𝔖_3' is the interlinear insertion; 'pour' is struck out but 'qui' is not.
The right-margin vertical note is a personal phone memo ('tél. 32 41 04 99 ... copie ...'), unrelated to the mathematics.
